extracted.name: Sautéed wild mushrooms
extracted.description: Serve these buttery mushrooms as a side with a rib of beef for an extra special Sunday roast, or stir through pasta or a risotto
ingredient_lines: ½ small pack parsley roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Clean the mushrooms of excess dirt using a small brush. If you need to wash them under cold water, do it quickly as mushrooms act like sponges and will soak up the water.

Melt the butter until foaming. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms and fry for 1-2 mins – try to keep the shape as this all adds to the presentation. Season and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and the parsley.
